text: {"lessons":["I’ll avoid reacting to short-term losses with rushed sales; I should decide in advance what would change my view of a holding.","My Stock B trades—selling at a loss, buying back at a higher price, then selling again at a loss—remind me to avoid churn and set clear reasons and limits before trading.","A few months of account results don’t show whether I’m beating the market; I’ll judge my decisions over longer periods against an appropriate benchmark."]}
